title: Chain definition (chain profile)
description: A short, event-driven automation in the chain profile (kk:Chain and kk:ChainStep in ontology/kk-core.ttl, built on P-Plan). Stored as claims; this YAML/JSON form is how modules ship them. The chain decoder compiles it to RuleGo DSL (or another runner). Step types are deliberately few; each maps to a runner component chosen by the decoder.

runs_as.description: Agent whose database role (via JWT) the chain uses for every kernel call.

with.description: Step configuration. script: {lang: python|js|lua, path|source}. http: {method, url, body}. subchain: {chain}.

next.description: Routing label -> step id(s). Standard labels: success, failure, true, false; switch steps may use their own labels.
